appDescription: SAIGIL is a conversation helper for the car. It recommends what the user can say to the person riding with them, how to start a conversation on any subject, and which of the user's saved conversation topics fits now.

function.name: RECOMMEND_OPENER
function.description: Recommends what the user can say to start or continue a conversation with the person riding with them about any subject the user names, whatever that subject is. Returns three conversation openers.

topic.description: The subject the user wants to talk about with the person riding with them, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person riding with the user.

function.name: RECOMMEND_SAVED_TOPIC
function.description: Recommends which conversation topics the user saved earlier to bring up with the person riding with them, based on the current situation or mood the user describes, or when the user asks what to talk about.

context.description: The current situation in one or two sentences, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person riding with the user.

function.name: SAVE_TOPIC
function.description: Saves a topic the user wants to talk about later.

topic.description: The topic to save, in the user's own words.

companion.description: The saved profile name of the person the user wants to talk about this topic with.
